gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-sogdian: Stencil-cut and loud: Wallpoet lets the paper show through its lettering. Noto Sans Old Sogdian follows with lowercase nearly as high as its capitals and wide mouths that stay crisp, working quietly beneath the heading's shout.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Noto Sans Old Turkic keeps its curves open-mouthed and clear, with a chunky lowercase. Noto Sans Old Turkic holds its own against Wallpoet's bold, smooth-bending display letters, and that sturdy standoff is the draw.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Wallpoet commands the top with smooth bends and see-through lines, bold enough to hold any headline. Noto Sans Oriya's generous curve gaps and near-capital lowercase make the contrast vivid.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-osage: Wallpoet rolls smooth, unobstructed curves across a bold heading, with paper showing through its lines. Noto Sans Osage fills its line with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping curves that never close up.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Wallpoet is all bold command, its bends smooth and unobstructed, with paper peeking between the letters. Noto Sans Samaritan supplies hefty lowercase and curves with plenty of daylight inside.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo is made for screen reading, with a sizable x-height and curves that leave their mouths unclosed. And Wallpoet handles the shouting with smooth bends, leaving the reading to its partner.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagr: Clean text sits under Wallpoet's bold heading, whose lines let the paper show through. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri carries longer text smoothly, with short ascenders and an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-syriac-east: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern reads openly, its lowercase nearly dwarfing the capitals and its curve endings staying far from one another. Wallpoet handles the loud headline while the body does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Loud and gap-lined, Wallpoet takes the top, its smooth bends set against a body with short ascenders. Noto Sans Tai Viet pulls its terminals back from each curve's close.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Wallpoet is loud, smooth, and gapped with paper showing through. Noto Sans Tamil sits beneath it looking magnified without growing, its terminals stopping well away from the stem, a quiet foil to the heading's bold shout.
